note: Game data read by reflection. Positions are metres [x, y, z]. A region without a polygon has only its bounding box (approximate). Landmark names come from the game's map registry (UserVisibleDescription); a name can have several spots: an NPC such as Zanik or Vannaka has a separate copy in each province (Luis, 2026-10-26). 'provinces' are the big areas players name (game EQuestRegion); the regions are their sub-regions, each with its 'province_source'.
